i.norm: Verifies that a malformed hex numeric entity ("&#X" with no valid hex digits and no semicolon) is left untranslated when the unescaper is constructed with no options (which defaults to semiColonRequired). The entire input -- including the incomplete entity prefix and the trailing null characters -- is returned verbatim.
Passing an empty options array causes the constructor to default to semiColonRequired.

Build a 7-char input whose first three characters form "&#X", the prefix of a hexadecimal numeric entity. The remaining four characters are null (�), which are not valid hex digits, and there is no terminating semicolon -- so the entity is malformed.
With semiColonRequired active and no valid hex digits present, translate() cannot decode the entity and passes every character through as-is.
